stories.title: Apple unveils M5 Ultra and M6 chips, its most powerful yet
stories.summary: Apple introduced two new chips, the M5 Ultra and the M6. The company calls the M5 Ultra its most powerful chip ever. Reports from TechCrunch and Hacker News confirm the announcement, but detailed specs and pricing were not included.
stories.whyItMatters: New silicon sets the pace for Apple's Mac lineup and its push into on-device AI, an area where it competes with Nvidia and Qualcomm.
whatToWatch: Which Mac models ship with the new chips
Developer response to new AI capabilities
questions: What are the exact performance gains over the prior generation?
When will devices with these chips go on sale?

stories.title: Apple's new desktops target local AI work, as it reverses an email privacy change
stories.summary: Apple unveiled new desktop computers built specifically for local AI development, according to Ars Technica. Separately, Engadget reported that Apple decided to undo a change it had made to an email privacy feature. Both moves came from Apple on the same day.
stories.whyItMatters: The new desktops show Apple chasing on-device AI workloads, while the privacy reversal points to added scrutiny over feature tradeoffs.
whatToWatch: Full specs and pricing for the new desktops
Whether the email privacy feature returns to its original design
questions: What exactly changed in the email privacy feature, and why did Apple reverse it?

stories.title: Robotics startup Generalist reportedly reaches $3 billion valuation
stories.summary: Robotics startup Generalist has reached a $3 billion valuation, TechCrunch reports, citing unnamed sources. No details on the funding round size or investors were included in the report.
stories.whyItMatters: The valuation shows continued investor appetite for robotics and physical-AI startups even as broader tech funding stays selective.
whatToWatch: An official funding announcement from Generalist
questions: What does Generalist build, and who is funding this round?

stories.title: Instagram's new First Draft tool auto-trims Reels clips
stories.summary: Instagram launched First Draft, a feature that automatically trims Reels clips to make editing less tedious. TechCrunch and The Verge both reported the rollout.
stories.whyItMatters: Meta keeps lowering the effort needed to make short-form video, sharpening its competition with TikTok for creator time and attention.
whatToWatch: Full rollout to all Instagram users
Creator feedback on the automatic edits
questions: How does the feature decide where to trim a clip?

stories.title: OpenAI loses a top data center executive amid ongoing departures
stories.summary: OpenAI has lost a senior data center executive, according to TechCrunch. The report frames this as the latest in a series of high-profile departures at the company.
stories.whyItMatters: Data center leadership is central to OpenAI's compute buildout, so repeated exits raise questions about stability as it scales infrastructure.
whatToWatch: Who OpenAI names to fill the role
questions: Why did the executive leave, and where are they going?
